title: I finally made it to the App Store
author: dazzling_abalone_865
selftext:
I'm not a professional programmer, but I've been building Hard Counter with AI as my coding partner, and it just went live on iOS (Android is in review).

The whole game is plain HTML/JS on a canvas, with no engine. AI wrote most of the code while I directed it: design, feel, what's fun, what's broken. I wrapped it for iOS and Android with Capacitor and built the iOS version in the cloud, since I'm on Windows. AdMob for ads, plus a few optional paid fighters. The sound and the trailer music are generated in code too.

**What AI was great at:** turning "the counter should feel heavier" into actual code changes, building lots of minigames quickly, fixing bugs once I could describe exactly what I saw.

**What it was bad at:** knowing whether something feels good. Every fighter, hit and animation took many rounds of me playing it and saying "no, faster", "bigger" or "less floaty". App Store setup, signing and review rules were also a long slog.

**Honest numbers:** 3 days live, about 15 downloads. Small, but people who see the store page download at around 60%, so now I'm working on getting it seen.  
I'd love feedback from people building this way.
